oracle.explanation: This oracle validates normal FormData usage first, then tests whether multipart boundary generation is predictably controlled by Math.random. It monkey-patches Math.random to a constant and creates two new FormData instances. If boundaries are identical under the fixed RNG, the unsafe-random vulnerability is present (exploit_succeeded=true). Patched behavior should not depend on Math.random in this way, yielding different/unrelated boundaries and exploit_succeeded=false.
